data.narrative:
The Red Metal Company is a Seed-stage private company in the Climate & Energy sector, founded by Jackson Switzer, having raised $10M to date. The valuation universe comprises one public comparable (ticker LNZA) and eight private peers in the broader climate and energy space, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

A single applicable valuation method—Stage-Progression—anchors this analysis. Using the $10M total raised as a proxy for current enterprise value and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage financing, this method implies a valuation of $25M. A Peer-Median approach could not be applied; while eight same-sector comparables exist, zero meet narrow stage-adjacency or valuation-tier filters required for reliable peer benchmarking, and falling back to all-sector medians would introduce misleading noise.

The triangulated valuation range is $21M (low) to $29M (high), with a median of $25M. This single-method result carries meaningful uncertainty: the absence of tightly-matched stage peers and the reliance on raised capital as a proxy valuation anchor both constrain confidence. Investors should treat this range as preliminary pending either identification of earlier-stage climate-tech comparables with disclosed valuations or access to management revenue/path-to-profitability forecasts.
